headline: RFP — Children’s Village Vendor
lead: Open solicitation for a preferred vendor to run Children’s Village / kids activity zones across cPALSs family events — starting Toy Drive 2026 and Elk Grove Lunar New Year 2027.

meta.description: Request for proposals: Children’s Village vendor for Elk Grove Toy Drive 2026 and Elk Grove Lunar New Year 2027. Activity menu + staffing. Proposals due Oct 17, 2026.

statusLine: Open for proposals · Due Fri Oct 17, 2026 · First event Toy Drive Dec 6, 2026

related.label: Related lot
related.text: Children’s Theater (kids stage show) is a separate RFP. You may bid one or both; awards may split.

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: cPALSs seeks a preferred vendor to organize Children’s Village / kids activity zones — ideally with an existing menu of activities you can adapt across our major family events — so Program is not inventing a new craft row each season.

Primary audience: roughly ages 2–10 (preschool through grade school), including toddler-friendly / early-exit options for younger siblings. Tweens/teens are out of scope for this Village product — see the separate Tween / Teen Maker Spot RFP.
The festival keeps product ownership: seasonal craft themes (for example collect the protectors at Lunar New Year), map placement, theater adjacency, and public story. You run the zone ops.

sections.title: Events in scope

rows: Sun Dec 6, 2026 · ~4 hr guest celebration · District 56
Kids activity / crafts footprint adapted to the indoor–outdoor venue
Sat + Sun Village (dry days; rain cancels the park day)
Slim Village / craft pocket with lantern-season skin when that festival returns

bullets: Out of scope: carnival rides · bounce houses · festival-owned inflatables · Children’s Theater stage bill (separate RFP) · writing our myth / World Bible content.
Prefer a vendor who already runs a catalog of kids activities and can show how you’d skin it for Christmas Toy Drive, Tết, and (later) lantern season — not only a one-off backyard birthday package.

orderedItems.label: Activity menu
orderedItems.text: What you already offer + adaptation plan for Toy Drive · EGLNY · (optional) next GLF.

orderedItems.label: Quotes
orderedItems.text: A — Toy Drive 2026 only. B — Toy Drive 2026 + EGLNY 2027 (preferred). Optional add — next Great Lantern Festival when dates are announced.

orderedItems.label: Festival kits
orderedItems.text: Willingness statement: run festival-supplied craft kits / stickers when we provide them.

sections.title: Constraints
bullets: No purchase required for a child to join a craft (optional spend OK elsewhere on site).
Theater pocket may sit in or near the Village — coordinate with the Theater producer; do not own that bill.
For outdoor park days: rain cancels the day — no indoor Village pivot is required in this scope.
Working planning envelopes exist per event; quotes may require a budget revisit — submit clear numbers.

rows: Existing activity menu + clear adaptation across Toy Drive + EGLNY (+ GLF when scheduled)
Comfort running our craft kits when supplied
Extra games / concessions (nice, not the core job)

sections.title: How to respond
paragraphs: Email your proposal to contact@cpalss.com with subject: cPALSs Children’s Village RFP.

Include: company overview · insurance summary · activity menu + adaptation plan · quote table (A/B + optional GLF) · staffing approach · references (2 festival or large outdoor kids events preferred).
Questions before the proposal deadline: same inbox, same subject line with — question appended.

contact.title: Submit a proposal
contact.intro: Prefer email. Attach PDFs or links; keep proposals readable.
